title: Desk Note on Reading the Unit Ledger: Late Fees of the Returned Period in a Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Catch-Up
content:
**Note.** The unit catch-up amount on a storage unit authorization under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization adds the returned period's late fees:

- **the late fee plus the second late fee**, where a second late fee is posted for the returned due date;
- **the late fee alone**, where only a late fee is posted for it;
- **nothing**, where neither is posted.

"The late fee" is the late fee counted in the unit catch-up amount; the second late fee is the figure of the agreement's unit class shown below.

**Records read.** The Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement ledger: fee entries of type late fee and of type second late fee whose period is the returned due date (the agreement's oldest unpaid due date). Fees posted for any other period are not read.

| Unit class | Second late fee |
|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | $15.00 |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | $15.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | $15.00 |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | $20.00 |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | $25.00 |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | $25.00 |

### Truth table

| Second late fee posted for the returned due date | Late fee posted for it | Added |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or No | Late fee plus second late fee |
| No | Yes | Late fee |
| No | No | Nothing |

### Worked (hypothetical, Bluegate Drive-Up Standard, late fee counted $28.00)

- Ledger shows a late fee and a second late fee for the returned due date: $28.00 plus $15.00, $43.00 added.
- Ledger shows only a late fee for the returned due date: $28.00 added.
- Ledger shows a late fee only for a later period: nothing added.
